blocks.text: Today's tag is $23.83, and that is what will be billed.
The card step will not raise it.
Canvas bib is available for eleven dollars and fifty nine cents and is not ticked.
Ordinary carrier cost is already inside today's tag. No packing line is added.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
Last week's tag on Wildflower honey jar, 12 oz was twenty nine dollars and seventy three cents.

product.description: The honey is raw and set in a glass jar with a metal lid.
